the length of the subarray is greater than or equal to 2.
al$$$a_l$$$ exists in the set bl,bl+1,⋯,br$$${b_l, b_{l+1},\cdots, b_r}$$$.

The second line contains n$$$n$$$ integers ai$$$a_i$$$ (1≤ai≤109)$$$(1 \le a_i \le 10^9)$$$ — the array a$$$a$$$.
The third line contains n$$$n$$$ integers bi$$$b_i$$$ (1≤bi≤109)$$$(1 \le b_i \le 10^9)$$$ — the array b$$$b$$$.
